method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Act: Compilation No. 32, compilation date 1 March 2024, includes amendments up to Act No. 76, 2023 (register id C2024C00063; C2004A02944), still the latest registered compilation on 21 October 2026, with its formulas (ss 29(4), 30(1), 44(3), 58(6)) in C2004A02944.formulas.md; read with Schedule 1 of the Treasury Laws Amendment (Genetic Testing Protections in Life Insurance and Other Measures) Act 2026 as made (C2026A00035, in force 8 October 2026, not yet compiled); Insurance Contracts Regulations 2017: Compilation No. 3, compilation date 8 October 2026, includes amendments F2026L01225 (register id F2026C01039; F2017L01658), with reg 38's formula in F2017L01658.formulas.md

scope: Act ss 4(1), 9(1)(a)-(e), (2), 11(1), (6), 11AB(1), (2), 12, 13(1), (2A), (3), (4), 14(1), 20A, 20B(1), (5), (5A), (6), 20E, 21(1)-(3A), 22(1), (3), (5)-(7), 23A, 25, 25A, 26, 27, 27AA, 28, 29(1)-(4), (6), (9), (10), 30(1), (2), 32(1), 33F, 33G(2), 33H, 35(1), (2), 37, 40(3), 43, 44(2), (3), 45(1), 46, 47(2)-(4), 53, 54, 56(1), 57(1)-(3), 58(2)-(6), 59(2), (2A), 68(2), 75D(2); amending Act No. 35, 2026 Sch 1 items 4 and 11; Regulations regs 10, 13A, 24, 26(3) items 1 and 2(a), 38 -- the insured's pre-contract duty (reasonable care for consumer contracts and for a life insured in super; disclosure otherwise), the insurer's s 22 notices, misrepresentation and relevant failure, the insurer's remedies for general and life insurance (including the 3-year limits, group life cover and the SP/Q formula), misstated age, protected genetic information in life insurance (what it is, no duty to disclose it, the insurer's ban on asking for or using it, and the s 47(4) disregard of an undiagnosed predisposition), the utmost good faith both ways and its civil penalty, terms the insurer may not rely on, the AS/P average-provision floor, s 54, claims-made notice, fraudulent claims, the reg 38 interest rate (Y + 3%) and interest, renewal notice and the premium for carried-on cover, cancellation notice, standard sickness and accident cover. Out: ASIC and administration, insurable interest, Key Facts Sheets, flood, interim and instalment contracts, third party beneficiaries' claims, subrogation, cancellation grounds, s 27A, ss 31 and 56(2) relief, ss 33E, 33J, 69, 71, 75, other standard covers
seat: the insured (and, for cover inside a super fund, the life insured)
